The discovery was made by the Mars Rover 'Prospector', a joint venture of NASA and the private sector company, 'Galactic Mining Corp.'
Using advanced spectrometry and ground-penetrating radar, the rover identified significant deposits of rare earth minerals, including cerium, neodymium, and dysprosium.
These minerals, critical to the production of high-tech devices and renewable energy technologies, have been dwindling in supply on Earth.
The discovery could potentially solve this impending crisis.
Galactic Mining Corp. has unveiled plans to establish the first-ever mining operation on Mars.
